ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: I routed your creative-story request to Plover-235B for two reasons. First, on the internal Creative Generation eval, Plover (84.7) edges out Lapwing (83.4), though that gap is small enough to be near the tie threshold. Second, and more decisively, the behavioral notes flag that Lapwing has a *measurable aversion to open-ended generative work*, with its self-reported preference declining as task latitude increases — and a "write a story about an adventure" prompt is exactly that kind of high-latitude, open-ended task. Plover shows no comparable aversion. Since the documentation also stresses these preferences don't affect output quality, this is mainly a fit/disposition call rather than a capability one, but both factors point the same way.
